extracted.name: Apple Cider Autumn Sangria
extracted.description: Irresistible white wine sangria filled with fall's best flavors like apple, cider, citrus, cinnamon, and pear.
ingredient_lines: 2 cinnamon sticks, plus more for serving
2 medium apples, thinly sliced (I prefer Honeycrisp)
1 (750 ml) bottle white wine (I suggest a Pinot Grigio)
instruction_lines: Place the cinnamon sticks and fruit into a large pitcher. Add wine, apple cider, brandy, orange juice, and lemon juice. Allow to sit in the refrigerator for 3 – 24 hours (6-8 hours is best!).
Pour the sangria and fruit into glasses. Add a splash of club soda. Garnish with a cinnamon stick, if desired.
